sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上，现场采访一些在商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today,
sentences.zh: 今天，

sentences.en: House Speaker Paul Ryan says his tax cuts are for the middle class, but that assumes that an economic tax plan where money goes to the wealthy and makes its way down works.
sentences.zh: 众议院议长保罗·瑞安称他的减税政策是为了中产阶级，但这假设了一种将资金流向富人并使其向下渗透的经济减税计划是有效的。

sentences.en: Love it or hate it, trickle-down economics is back.
sentences.zh: 无论你喜欢还是讨厌，涓滴经济学又回来了。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月13日，星期一。

sentences.en: Peter Goodman, what happened to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 彼得·古德曼，美国的

sentences.en: tax code in the early 1980s?
sentences.zh: 税法在20世纪80年代初发生了什么？

sentences.en: So what happened was a fellow by the name of Ronald Reagan was elected president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 当时发生的事情是，一位名叫罗纳德·里根的人当选为美国总统。

sentences.en: He had campaigned as the avowed enemy of the so-called pencil-necked bureaucrats of Washington.
sentences.zh: 他竞选时自称是华盛顿那些所谓“细脖子官僚”的死敌。

sentences.en: We're going to put an end to the money merry-go-round where our money becomes Washington's money to be spent by states and cities exactly the way the
sentences.zh: 我们要终结那种资金循环游戏，即我们的钱变成了华盛顿的钱，然后由各州和各城市按照

sentences.en: federal bureaucrats tell us it has to be spent.
sentences.zh: 联邦官僚告诉我们必须花费的方式去花掉。

sentences.en: And he promised that he was going to take power away from the people who were confiscating the hard-earned wealth, the working people of America,
sentences.zh: 他承诺要从那些没收美国劳动人民辛苦赚来的财富的人手中夺回权力，

sentences.en: and give it back to those working people and to businesses.
sentences.zh: 并将其归还给那些劳动人民和企业。

sentences.en: And so he came in and he slashed corporate tax rates.
sentences.zh: 于是他上任后大幅削减了企业税率。

sentences.en: He slashed individual tax rates.
sentences.zh: 他削减了个人所得税率。

sentences.en: He slashed the top tax rates, which at that point still reached somewhere around 70 percent.
sentences.zh: 他削减了最高税率，当时最高税率仍高达70%左右。

sentences.en: And he dropped them first into the 50s and eventually into the 30s.
sentences.zh: 他先将其降至50%左右，最终降至30%左右。

sentences.en: And what was the big economic argument behind these Reagan tax cuts?
sentences.zh: 那么，里根减税政策背后的重大经济论点是什么？

sentences.en: It was this elegant idea that if you gave more freedom to businesses and individuals, you gave them control over their
sentences.zh: 这是一个优雅的理念：如果你给企业和个人更多的自由，让他们掌控自己的

sentences.en: money, that businesses would invest more, they would hire more, consumers would go out and spend on productive things and jobs and economic growth would result.
sentences.zh: 金钱，企业就会增加投资，增加雇佣，消费者就会去消费，从而带动就业和经济增长。

sentences.en: We can't have jobs unless the people have both money to invest and the faith to invest it.
sentences.zh: 除非人们既有钱投资，又有信心去投资，否则我们就不可能有就业机会。

sentences.en: This theory has a name.
sentences.zh: 这个理论有一个名字。

sentences.en: The name is...
sentences.zh: 名字叫……

sentences.en: Supply-side economics is the branch of economics.
sentences.zh: 供给侧经济学是经济学的一个分支。

sentences.en: Supply-side economics.
sentences.zh: 供给侧经济学。

sentences.en: Trickle-down economics is the idea that cutting tax rates...
sentences.zh: 涓滴经济学是指这样一种观点：削减税率……

sentences.en: Back in the 1890s, according to the economist John Kenneth Galbraith, there was the notion of the horse and
sentences.zh: 早在19世纪90年代，根据经济学家约翰·肯尼思·加尔布雷思的说法，有一种“马与
zh_words: 约翰·肯尼思·加尔布雷思

sentences.en: sparrow theory, the idea that if you feed a horse more oats, the horse will get nice and fat, but will
sentences.zh: 麻雀”理论，即如果你给马喂更多的燕麦，马会变得又肥又壮，但也会

sentences.en: also pass along more of the nutrients to the sparrows who come and feast on the manure.
sentences.zh: 把更多的营养物质排泄出来，供那些来吃粪便的麻雀享用。

sentences.en: This is literally a theory that things will pass from the top down to the bottom, whether it's the rich to the poor or the horse to the sparrow.
sentences.zh: 这字面上就是一个理论，即事物会从上层向下层传递，无论是从富人到穷人，还是从马到麻雀。

sentences.en: The idea is that if the people at the top of the economic pyramid are feeling wealthy, then they'll go out and spend, and everybody further on down will collect a cut.
sentences.zh: 其理念是，如果经济金字塔顶端的人感到富有，他们就会去消费，而下面的人就能分到一杯羹。

sentences.en: That's the idea.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个理念。

sentences.en: Together, we can forge a new beginning for America.
sentences.zh: 让我们共同为美国开创一个新的开端。

sentences.en: Thank you, and good night.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家，晚安。

sentences.en: So, Peter, after Reagan cut taxes, when is the next time we see trickle-down-style tax cuts put into place in the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，在里根减税之后，我们下一次在美国看到涓滴式减税是什么时候？

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: is feeling the hangover from the dot-com bubble.
sentences.zh: 正感受着互联网泡沫破裂后的宿醉。

sentences.en: It was the worst single-day point loss ever for both exchanges, the Dow and the Nasdaq plummeting.
sentences.zh: 那是道琼斯指数和纳斯达克指数有史以来单日跌幅最大的一次，两市均暴跌。

sentences.en: And there's a recession.
sentences.zh: 而且出现了经济衰退。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: I have a tax relief for all people who pay the bills in America, because I think you can spend your money more wisely than the federal government can.
sentences.zh: 我为所有支付美国账单的人提供了减税政策，因为我认为你们比联邦政府更能明智地花钱。

sentences.en: George W.
sentences.zh: 乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush comes into office, and George W.
sentences.zh: 布什上任了，乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush delivers $1.35 trillion worth of tax cuts over the next decade.
sentences.zh: 布什在接下来的十年里实施了价值1.35万亿美元的减税措施。

sentences.en: The vast majority of the benefits of these tax cuts go to the wealthiest people.
sentences.zh: 这些减税带来的绝大部分好处都流向了最富有的人。

sentences.en: So, in both the case of Reagan and Bush, the promise was that large tax cuts would trickle through the economy.
sentences.zh: 所以，在里根和布什的案例中，承诺都是大规模减税会渗透到整个经济中。

sentences.en: And even if they might especially help the well-off, they would create a lot of economic benefit to everybody else in the middle and the working class.
sentences.zh: 即使它们可能特别有助于富人，也会为中产阶级和工人阶级的其他人创造巨大的经济利益。

sentences.en: Is that what actually happened?
sentences.zh: 事实真的如此吗？

sentences.en: Broadly, no.
sentences.zh: 大体上没有。

sentences.en: What has happened instead is that wealthy people have gotten much wealthier.
sentences.zh: 相反发生的情况是，富人变得更富了。

sentences.en: The super-rich are getting richer.
sentences.zh: 超级富豪变得越来越富有。

sentences.en: More and more of the spoils of American economic growth have flowed to the top 10 percent of income earners, and the bottom 90 percent has fallen further away.
sentences.zh: 美国经济增长的成果越来越多地流向了收入最高的那10%的人群，而底层90%的人群则被进一步甩在后面。

sentences.en: And we can see this, particularly if we look at what's happened to wages since the mid-1970s,
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到这一点，特别是如果我们观察自20世纪70年代中期以来工资的变化，

sentences.en: where the vast majority of American working people, roughly 80 percent of the workforce, have seen their wages decline in real terms, which is to say,
sentences.zh: 绝大多数美国劳动者，大约80%的劳动力，其实际工资都在下降，也就是说，

sentences.en: after you factor in what you bring home in your paycheck, and you look at what it costs you for housing, health care, and other costs that have gone up,
sentences.zh: 在你扣除工资收入，并考虑到住房、医疗和其他上涨的成本后，

sentences.en: the average American worker, most American workers, has ended up with less since the mid-1970s.
sentences.zh: 自20世纪70年代中期以来，普通美国工人的收入实际上变少了。

sentences.en: And these two experiences with trickle-down economics has not only failed to address that, it's in fact made it worse.
sentences.zh: 而这两次涓滴经济学的实践不仅未能解决这个问题，反而使其变得更糟。

sentences.en: The richest Americans made nearly 20 percent of all the available income in America last year.
sentences.zh: 去年，最富有的美国人获得了美国近20%的可支配收入。

sentences.en: That's the widest income gap since the roaring 20s.
sentences.zh: 这是自“咆哮的二十年代”以来最大的贫富差距。

sentences.en: Most of the sort of mainstream economists will tell you the trickle-down economics is this elegant theory that has never actually worked.
sentences.zh: 大多数主流经济学家会告诉你，涓滴经济学是一个从未真正奏效的优雅理论。

sentences.en: And if you try it again, what you'll get is a greater economic inequality and diminished economic growth.
sentences.zh: 如果你再次尝试，你只会得到更大的经济不平等和减缓的经济增长。

sentences.en: And you may get a boom in the stock market, but it will not lead to this sort of robust economic growth
sentences.zh: 你可能会看到股市繁荣，但这并不会带来那种能够真正惠及经济金字塔中下层的

sentences.en: that would in fact reach all the way down to the middle and the bottom of the economic pyramid.
sentences.zh: 强劲经济增长。

sentences.en: Most mainstream economists just do not buy that story, and they're more skeptical of it now than they were back in the 80s.
sentences.zh: 大多数主流经济学家根本不买账，他们现在比80年代时更加怀疑这一理论。

sentences.en: And we're live now at the Ways and Means Committee Room on Capitol Hill for the Republicans' announcement on their tax reform plan.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在国会山的筹款委员会会议室进行直播，共和党人正在宣布他们的税改计划。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎。

sentences.en: It is great to have you here with us today.
sentences.zh: 很高兴今天你能和我们在一起。

sentences.en: Fantastic.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: This plan is for the middle-class families in this country who deserve a break.
sentences.zh: 这项计划是为这个国家值得喘息机会的中产阶级家庭制定的。

sentences.en: It is for the families who are out there living paycheck to paycheck who just keep getting squeezed.
sentences.zh: 它是为那些靠工资过活、不断受到挤压的家庭制定的。

sentences.en: The Tax Cut and Jobs Act will deliver real relief for people in the middle, people who are also striving to get there.
sentences.zh: 《减税与就业法案》将为中产阶级以及那些努力跻身中产阶级的人们带来真正的减负。

sentences.en: So what is Paul Ryan now proposing with his tax plan in the House?
sentences.zh: 那么保罗·瑞安现在在众议院提出的税改计划是什么？

sentences.en: The House bill involves essentially $1.5 trillion in tax cuts over the next decade.
sentences.zh: 众议院法案本质上涉及在未来十年内减税1.5万亿美元。

sentences.en: Roughly a trillion of that goes to businesses in the form of lowering corporate taxes,
sentences.zh: 其中大约一万亿以降低企业税的形式流向企业，

sentences.en: and then something like $300 billion goes to individuals, mostly higher income and some middle income,
sentences.zh: 大约3000亿流向个人，主要是高收入者和部分中等收入者，

sentences.en: and then $200 billion goes almost entirely to wealthy people through repeal of the estate tax.
sentences.zh: 还有2000亿几乎全部通过废除遗产税流向了富人。

sentences.en: And oh, by the way, when you get our tax rates down on our businesses as deeply as we're dropping them in the bill we're proposing, that's good for everyone.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，当我们像法案中提议的那样大幅降低企业税率时，这对每个人都有好处。

sentences.en: So two-thirds of this bill is going to corporate tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 所以这项法案的三分之二将用于企业减税。

sentences.en: One-third is going to individual tax cuts, some of which is going to the middle class, but most of which is going to higher-income people.
sentences.zh: 三分之一用于个人减税，其中一部分流向中产阶级，但大部分流向了高收入人群。

sentences.en: That sounds like trickle-down.
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是涓滴经济学。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: President Trump and Republicans believe bigger corporate profits will have a trickle-down effect, creating more jobs and higher wages.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统和共和党人认为，更大的企业利润会产生涓滴效应，从而创造更多的就业机会和更高的工资。

sentences.en: They insist on the same old myth of trickle-down tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 他们坚持涓滴减税这一陈旧的神话。

sentences.en: The entire economic theory that Senate Republicans and President Trump have embraced with this budget is called trickle-down economics.
sentences.zh: 参议院共和党人和特朗普总统在预算案中所采纳的整个经济理论被称为涓滴经济学。

sentences.en: This whole theory is a fraud and has been, when it applied, an abysmal failure.
sentences.zh: 整个理论都是一场骗局，而且在应用时，它一直是一场惨败。

sentences.en: What are some of the reasons why Speaker Paul Ryan thinks that this tax plan and the philosophy behind it will work, despite some of the historical context?
sentences.zh: 尽管有一些历史背景，保罗·瑞安议长认为这项税改计划及其背后的哲学能够奏效的原因是什么？

sentences.en: He is saying that if you cut taxes, we will see businesses go out and hire and create good jobs.
sentences.zh: 他认为，如果你减税，我们就会看到企业去雇人并创造好的就业机会。

sentences.en: And that suggests that we live in an America today where all these business leaders would love to hire people, but they just don't have any money.
sentences.zh: 这暗示我们今天生活在一个美国，所有的商业领袖都想雇人，但他们只是没钱。

sentences.en: And that's just demonstrably ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 这显然是荒谬的。

sentences.en: It's very difficult to imagine that the problem with the shortage of high-paying jobs is that companies don't have enough money.
sentences.zh: 很难想象高薪职位短缺的问题是因为公司没有足够的钱。

sentences.en: American companies are earning, in many cases, record profits.
sentences.zh: 美国公司在许多情况下都在赚取创纪录的利润。

sentences.en: The idea that if you give them even more money, well, then they'll go higher, that's very hard to square with economic reality.
sentences.zh: 如果你给他们更多的钱，他们就会去雇人，这种想法很难与经济现实相符。

sentences.en: American businesses have plenty of money at the ready to go and hire people and pay people higher wages than they're paying now.
sentences.zh: 美国企业有充足的资金去雇人，并支付比现在更高的工资。

sentences.en: And they're not doing that.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有这样做。

sentences.en: They're not hiring people at higher wages for a whole bunch of reasons that have nothing to do with tax reform.
sentences.zh: 他们没有以更高的工资雇人，原因有很多，这些原因与税改毫无关系。

sentences.en: And the idea that if you give companies a break on their corporate taxation, that will somehow change their incentive to pay their workers more,
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你给公司减税，就能改变他们给员工涨工资的激励机制，这种想法，

sentences.en: well, that goes against the grain of what we've seen play out in the United States over the last half century.
sentences.zh: 与过去半个世纪我们在美国看到的情况背道而驰。

sentences.en: When corporations have ended up with more in their coffers, what they've done again and again is they've handed out bigger bonuses to executives,
sentences.zh: 当企业最终拥有更多资金时，他们一次又一次做的是给高管发放更高的奖金，

sentences.en: bigger dividends to shareholders, and hired top-notch people at the high end while continuing to squeeze everybody else as an unwanted coSt.
sentences.zh: 给股东发放更多的股息，并在高端领域聘请顶尖人才，同时继续将其他人视为不必要的成本进行挤压。

sentences.en: And that dynamic does not change through any form of corporate tax relief that's on the table now.
sentences.zh: 而这种动态不会通过目前提出的任何形式的企业减税来改变。

sentences.en: You know, a family of four in America has a median income of $59,000.
sentences.zh: 你知道，美国一个四口之家的收入中位数是59,000美元。

sentences.en: That person's, that family's going to get a $1,200 tax cut.
sentences.zh: 那个家庭将获得1,200美元的减税。

sentences.en: Paul Ryan nevertheless still seems to argue that this tax plan that he's championing is very much for the middle class.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，保罗·瑞安似乎仍然坚持认为他所倡导的这项税改计划非常符合中产阶级的利益。

sentences.en: We really believe that getting this middle-income tax cut and then getting our tax system so that it makes sense to stay in America as a business
sentences.zh: 我们真心相信，获得这种中等收入减税，然后理顺我们的税制，使企业留在美国

sentences.en: and hire Americans means we'll get more jobs and higher wages and we'll give a break to people struggling in this country, and that's good for the economy.
sentences.zh: 并雇佣美国人变得合理，意味着我们将获得更多的就业机会和更高的工资，并为这个国家挣扎的人们提供喘息机会，这对经济是有利的。

sentences.en: So why do you think, given everything you've just said about how this actually has worked in the past, that he might believe that so strongly?
sentences.zh: 那么，考虑到你刚才所说的关于它在过去实际运作的情况，你认为他为什么会如此坚定地相信这一点？

sentences.en: You know, there's something very deep in modern American culture that makes us susceptible to buy into narratives that involve government being the enemy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现代美国文化中有一种非常深刻的东西，使我们容易接受那种将政府视为敌人的叙事。

sentences.en: And Paul Ryan comes very much out of that tradition.
sentences.zh: 而保罗·瑞安正是深受这种传统的影响。

sentences.en: I mean, this idea that any money you give the government is money that's just going to be squandered, wasted, by some idealistic, out-of-touch bureaucrat
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，任何你给政府的钱都会被某个理想主义的、脱离现实的官僚挥霍掉、浪费掉，

sentences.en: who never gets out into the real America and understands the struggles of real people.
sentences.zh: 他从不深入真实的美国，也不了解普通人的挣扎。

sentences.en: But we have to look at where the money is actually going.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须看看钱到底流向了哪里。

sentences.en: This idea that you give money to people at the top and everybody below hopes that somehow, through the magic of the horse and sparrow theory
sentences.zh: 那种给顶层的人钱，然后下面的人希望通过“马与麻雀”理论的魔法，

sentences.en: or trickle-down or supply-side or whatever you want to call it, they're going to come out ahead.
sentences.zh: 或者涓滴经济学、供给侧经济学，或者任何你想叫的名字，他们就能领先的想法。

sentences.en: And again, I mean, the evidence shows that that has actually happened zero times.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，证据表明这种情况实际上一次都没有发生过。

sentences.en: So if this model hasn't worked in the past, Peter, why does this idea of trickle-down economics keep coming up when we talk about how tax policy should work in this country?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这个模式在过去没有奏效，彼得，为什么当我们谈论这个国家的税收政策应该如何运作时，涓滴经济学的想法总是不断出现？

sentences.en: A combination of ruthless self-interest and economic illiteracy.
sentences.zh: 这是无情的私利和经济文盲的结合。

sentences.en: I mean, I was at the World Economic Forum in Davos in January.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一月份我在达沃斯参加世界经济论坛。

sentences.en: Your Majesty, distinguished heads of state and government, excellencies.
sentences.zh: 陛下，各位杰出的国家元首和政府首脑，阁下们。

sentences.en: This is, you know, the annual meeting of the masters of the universe who control all the money.
sentences.zh: 这是控制着所有资金的“宇宙大师”们的年度会议。

sentences.en: A very cordial welcome to the 47th annual meeting of the World Economic Forum.
sentences.zh: 非常热烈地欢迎各位参加世界经济论坛第47届年会。

sentences.en: We meet here at an extraordinary moment of history.
sentences.zh: 我们在此相聚于历史的一个非凡时刻。

sentences.en: We are in the midst of a deep transformation of economies, of society, of politics.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于经济、社会和政治深刻转型的过程中。

sentences.en: And we are here to construct the future.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里是为了构建未来。

sentences.en: And I was having dinner with a preeminent economist who had just come from a meeting of hedge fund billionaires and private equity managers.
sentences.zh: 当时我和一位杰出的经济学家共进晚餐，他刚从一场对冲基金亿万富翁和私募股权经理的会议中出来。

sentences.en: And he said that to a head, they were all extremely enthusiastic about the Trump presidency.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们所有人对特朗普总统任期都极其热情。

sentences.en: This is happening, you know, the week before Trump is inaugurated.
sentences.zh: 这发生在特朗普就职前一周。

sentences.en: Because the one thing they can see happening is tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 因为他们能预见到的唯一事情就是减税。

sentences.en: That that alone, not, you know, infrastructure spending, not some plan to boost wages and spending power for consumers.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是这一点，而不是基础设施支出，也不是什么提高消费者工资和消费能力的计划。

sentences.en: The one thing they could see working out in their worldview was tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 在他们的世界观中，他们能预见到唯一能奏效的事情就是减税。

sentences.en: And we've seen evidence that these people are voting with their dollars because we've had this extraordinary run-up in the stock market since Trump has been inaugurated.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到证据表明这些人正在用他们的美元投票，因为自特朗普就职以来，股市出现了非凡的上涨。

sentences.en: A lot of reasons to cheer.
sentences.zh: 有很多值得欢呼的理由。

sentences.en: Millions of Americans are making big money.
sentences.zh: 数百万美国人正在赚大钱。

sentences.en: Your stocks or 401k have likely gone up recently.
sentences.zh: 你的股票或401k退休金账户最近很可能上涨了。

sentences.en: The Dow Jones hit an all-time high today, going over 22,000 for the first time ever.
sentences.zh: 道琼斯指数今天创下历史新高，首次突破22,000点。

sentences.en: Apple stocks...
sentences.zh: 苹果股票……

sentences.en: But how that somehow translates into economic growth for everybody else, we're still waiting for that.
sentences.zh: 但这一切如何转化为其他所有人的经济增长，我们仍在等待。

sentences.en: I mean, we've been waiting for that now for four decades.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们已经为此等待了四十年了。

sentences.en: And so this idea is the idea that never dies because the first part of it, the part where wealthy people get massive tax breaks, that part actually does happen.
sentences.zh: 所以这个理念之所以永不消亡，是因为它的第一部分，即富人获得巨额税收减免的那部分，确实发生了。

sentences.en: And that part can always happen.
sentences.zh: 而且那部分总是会发生。

sentences.en: And so there's always a temptation for people who like the idea of paying less in taxes if they have a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于那些有钱且喜欢少缴税这一想法的人来说，总会有一种诱惑。

sentences.en: There's always the temptation to persuade somebody that the trickle-down story will really work this time.
sentences.zh: 总有人试图说服别人，认为“涓滴经济学”这次真的会奏效。

sentences.en: You're going to see numbers and you're going to see growth and you're going to see jobs and you're going to see really wages going up.
sentences.zh: 你会看到数字，看到增长，看到就业机会，还会看到工资真正上涨。

sentences.en: And something we're seeing now is, for the first time in a long time, wages are starting to rise for people.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到的是，长期以来第一次，人们的工资开始上涨了。

sentences.en: In some cases, they've been 18 to 21 years without a real salary increase or wage increase.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们已经有18到21年没有真正涨过工资或薪水了。

sentences.en: So a lot of good things are happening, but this is the final element, tax cuts and tax reform.
sentences.zh: 所以很多好的事情正在发生，但这是最后的一环，即减税和税制改革。

sentences.en: Thank you, Peter.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，彼得。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Thursday, Senate Republicans released their own version of the tax plan in response to criticism that the House proposal was not in fact for the middle class.
sentences.zh: 周四，参议院共和党人发布了他们自己的税改计划版本，以回应外界关于众议院提案实际上并非针对中产阶级的批评。

sentences.en: The Senate plan would delay a major cut in the corporate tax rate by a year and reinstate several tax breaks used by middle-class families.
sentences.zh: 参议院的计划将把企业税率的大幅削减推迟一年，并恢复几项中产阶级家庭使用的税收减免政策。

sentences.en: Both chambers are under pressure to pass a tax reform bill by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 两院都面临着在年底前通过税改法案的压力。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, President Trump and the former directors of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周末，特朗普总统与美国前情报机构负责人之间，

sentences.en: intelligence agencies went back and forth over the president's comments that he believed Vladimir Putin when he said Russia did not meddle in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 就总统称他相信弗拉基米尔·普京关于俄罗斯没有干预2016年大选的说法，展开了反复交锋。

sentences.en: On Saturday, talking to reporters on board Air Force One, the president dismissed the intelligence chiefs, who have all said meddling occurred, as hacks.
sentences.zh: 周六，总统在空军一号上对记者发表谈话时，将那些都表示干预确实发生过的情报主管们斥为“黑客”。

sentences.en: By not confronting the issue directly and not acknowledging to Putin that we know that you're responsible for this, I think he's giving Putin a pass.
sentences.zh: 我认为，他不直接面对这个问题，也不向普京承认我们知道他对此负有责任，这是在纵容普京。

sentences.en: On Sunday morning, former CIA director John Brennan went on CNN to criticize the president's comments.
sentences.zh: 周日上午，前中情局局长约翰·布伦南在CNN上批评了总统的言论。

sentences.en: And I think it demonstrates to Mr. Putin that Donald Trump can be played by foreign leaders who are going to appeal to his ego and to try to play upon his insecurities,
sentences.zh: 我认为这向普京先生表明，唐纳德·特朗普可以被那些迎合他虚荣心并试图利用他不安感的外国领导人所操纵，

sentences.en: which is very, very worrisome from a national security standpoint.
sentences.zh: 从国家安全的角度来看，这非常、非常令人担忧。

sentences.en: Brennan was joined by the former director of national intelligence,
sentences.zh: 与布伦南一同出席的还有前国家情报总监，

sentences.en: James Clapper, who suggested the president is being manipulated with flattery by leaders like Putin.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·克拉珀，他暗示总统正受到像普京这样的领导人的阿谀奉承所操纵。

sentences.en: You know, he seems very susceptible to rolling out the red carpet and honor guards and all this, all the trappings and pomp and circumstance that come with the office.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他似乎很容易被红地毯、仪仗队以及所有这些随职权而来的排场和礼仪所打动。

sentences.en: And I think that that appeals to him and I think it plays to his insecurities.
sentences.zh: 我认为这吸引了他，也利用了他的不安感。

sentences.en: On Sunday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 周日下午。

sentences.en: I believe that President Putin really feels, and he feels strongly, that he did not meddle in our election.
sentences.zh: 我相信普京总统确实认为，而且他坚定地认为，他没有干预我们的选举。

sentences.en: What he believes is what he believes.
sentences.zh: 他相信什么就是什么。

sentences.en: The president walked back his original remarks about Putin.
sentences.zh: 总统收回了他最初关于普京的言论。

sentences.en: I'm with our agencies, especially as currently constituted with their leadership.
sentences.zh: 我支持我们的机构，特别是目前由其领导层组成的机构。

sentences.en: I believe in our intel agencies.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们的情报机构。

sentences.en: And everybody in this room, every person watching on these cameras should ask theirself, isn't it strange that after 40 years of constant investigation,
sentences.zh: 在这个房间里的每一个人，每一个通过摄像机观看的人都应该问问自己，难道不奇怪吗？在经历了40年的持续调查之后，

sentences.en: people have waited to four weeks prior to the general election to bring their complaints?
sentences.zh: 人们竟然等到大选前四周才提出他们的投诉？

sentences.en: That's not a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 那不是巧合。

sentences.en: It's an intentional act to stop campaign.
sentences.zh: 这是阻止竞选的蓄意行为。

sentences.en: Roy Moore, the Republican Senate nominee in Alabama's special election, is resisting calls to end his campaign amid allegations he made sexual advances towards teenage girls.
sentences.zh: 罗伊·摩尔，阿拉巴马州特别选举中的共和党参议员候选人，正在抵制要求他结束竞选的呼声，此前有指控称他对少女进行了性骚扰。

sentences.en: Instead, both Moore and his political ally, former White House strategist Steve Bannon, are seeking to discredit the women who have spoken out
sentences.zh: 相反，摩尔和他的政治盟友、前白宫战略家史蒂夫·班农都在试图抹黑那些站出来发声的女性，

sentences.en: and the newspaper that first reported their claiMs.
sentences.zh: 以及首先报道她们指控的报纸。

sentences.en: The Bezos-Amazon-Washington Post that dropped that dime on Donald Trump is the same Bezos-Amazon-Washington Post that dropped the dime this afternoon on Judge Roy Moore.
sentences.zh: 那个向唐纳德·特朗普爆料的贝佐斯-亚马逊-《华盛顿邮报》，就是今天下午向罗伊·摩尔法官爆料的同一个贝佐斯-亚马逊-《华盛顿邮报》。

sentences.en: Now, is that a coincidence?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是巧合吗？

sentences.en: That's what I mean when I say opposition party, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是我所说的“反对党”的意思，对吧？

sentences.en: In an interview with The Times,
sentences.zh: 在接受《时报》采访时，

sentences.en: Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell declined to say whether he would seat Moore if he wins in the December special election and deflected a question
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔拒绝透露如果摩尔在12月的特别选举中获胜，他是否会让他就职，并回避了一个问题，

sentences.en: about whether Republicans would support a write-in candidate to run against Moore.
sentences.zh: 即共和党人是否会支持一名“写名候选人”来与摩尔竞争。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正准备迎接假期期间的客人。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会因为昏厥而入睡。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.zh: 当天气说...
